terminal_case_rule.status: paused by Yegor; do not unpause or close from this runbook
terminal_case_rule.rule: Closed, done, cancelled, error, or otherwise terminal Workflow Engine cases must not receive new routed work, new tasks, new event waits, or subscription resumes. Recovery must quarantine and audit any attempted dispatch to a terminal/closed case instead of routing it.

runtime_state_boundaries.rollback_limit: Redis is the active runtime store for cases, work items, subscriptions, waits, reminders, streams, and in-flight dispatch receipts. Code rollback does not rewind those objects.
blocked_recovery: manual stream surgery without incident owner and reviewer acceptance

runtime_state_boundaries.rollback_limit: PostgreSQL is shadow/durable evidence until a separately accepted PG_READ cutover. onlyInRedis is a blocker; onlyInPG is retention debt when Redis is complete.
blocked_recovery: manual production public schema mutation without incident issue

runtime_state_boundaries.rollback_limit: Subscriptions and event waits represent live resume points. They must be cancelled or recreated by explicit runtime actions, not broad key cleanup.
blocked_recovery: delete all subscriptions for a trigger without affected case list

runtime_state_boundaries.rollback_limit: Scheduled reminders may already have fired or may be queued. Rollback cannot unsend reminder effects.
External sends and duplicate dispatches cannot be unsent. Recovery must stop additional sends, record duplicates, and reconcile receipts.
Work items are user-visible assignments. Cancel, complete, or update them only through Action Spine/admin APIs so audit records exist.
Running cases must be completed, cancelled, or quarantined explicitly. A code revert does not change active case status.
blocked_recovery: starting replacement cases before terminal-case checks and duplicate-dispatch review

signals: case status stays running past SLA
work item has no reachable assignee
commands: curl -sS -X POST "$KONOHA_URL/act" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KONOHA_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"action":"case.cancel","category":"act","args":{"id":"<case_id>","reason":"stuck-running-case recovery issue #<incident>"}}'
blockers: case is terminal but has new routed work
no owner/reviewer acceptance for destructive cleanup
abort_criteria: duplicate external dispatch risk is not bounded
recovery_scenarios.audit: Attach commands, receipts, before/after case state, and reviewer acceptance to the incident or release issue.

signals: case.get shows terminal or missing wait owner
subscription.list shows instance_id with no running case
blockers: subscription belongs to active non-incident case
warnings: wait was already removed by runtime
abort_criteria: terminal-case rule from #812 would be violated
recovery_scenarios.audit: Record each cancelled subscription id and the case status that justified cancellation.

signals: two task messages for one work_item_id
agent reports already handled work item
blockers: duplicate was delivered to external connector and may have user impact
case is terminal but received a new task
warnings: duplicate was internal-only and idempotently ignored
abort_criteria: cannot prove which dispatch was first
operator would need to send another external message
recovery_scenarios.audit: Keep both dispatch receipts; do not delete duplicate messages from streams.

blockers: no owner approval for external resend
warnings: retry queued but connector remains degraded
recovery_scenarios.audit: Record resend approval, exact target, idempotency key, and connector receipt.

signals: new workflow definition exists but subscriptions or snapshots are incomplete
staging smoke passes but production smoke fails after deploy
blockers: active cases exist on the partially deployed workflow and need case-level recovery
abort_criteria: manual data cleanup would be required without approval
recovery_scenarios.audit: Link revert commit and affected workflow ids in the review issue.

warnings: dry-run only because no live staging exists
abort_criteria: deploy would create subscriptions for an invalid definition
recovery_scenarios.audit: Attach deploy dry-run output and action-surface check to the issue.

blockers: terminal-case rule from #812 would be violated
warnings: existing running cases may continue on old snapshot
abort_criteria: reviewed definition payload changes unrelated workflow fields
recovery_scenarios.audit: Store the exact reviewed definition payload, workflow.get before/after output, and update receipt.

signals: assistant proposes destructive action without confirmation
warnings: proposal was rejected before side effects
abort_criteria: trace is missing or redacted beyond reviewability
recovery_scenarios.audit: Attach trace id, action receipt, and rejection/confirmation record.

blockers: reconcile dry-run touches unexpected recipients or tables
abort_criteria: dry-run plan does not match incident scope
recovery_scenarios.audit: Keep dry-run output before apply; apply is allowed only after reviewer acceptance.

destructive_data_gate.default: dry-run first; no destructive production data command is part of the normal runbook
requires: exact affected workflow ids, case ids, Redis keys, PostgreSQL tables, or connector receipts

audit_artifacts: GitHub issue comment with commands and commit hash
